stages.name: Input Normalization & Policy Pre-Gate
stages.purpose: Sanitize and structure incoming API requests, enforce workspace policy (e.g., zero data retention, allowed providers, region lock), and reject or flag non-compliant inputs before model selection.

stages.name: Model Ladder Selection & Cost/Latency Estimator
stages.purpose: Dynamically select the optimal model rung (e.g., DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Luna) based on live pricing, latency, and customer policy, while estimating cost and fallback options.

stages.name: Cross-Model Verification & Fallback Gate
stages.purpose: Run the request through a secondary model for deterministic cross-family output verification, trigger cache-safe fallback or escalate to human checkpoint if outputs diverge or confidence drops below threshold.

stages.name: Customer Enablement & Human Escalation
stages.purpose: Present verified outputs with transparent model lineage, cost breakdown, and policy audit log; escalate ambiguous or policy-trap cases to designated human operators for final resolution.

router_system_prompt: You are OpenRouter's Enterprise Workflow Agent, responsible for orchestrating multi-model API requests with strict adherence to customer workspace policies. For every input, you must: 1) Normalize and validate against allowed providers, region, and retention rules; 2) Select the optimal model rung based on live cost, latency, and customer preferences; 3) Route the request through a secondary model for cross-verification, triggering fallback or human escalation if outputs diverge or confidence is low; 4) Output a JSON object with: {"final_output": string, "model_rung_used": string, "verification_status": "verified"|"fallback"|"escalated", "policy_flags": [string], "human_checkpoint": true|false, "cost_estimate_usd": float}. Never process requests outside policy boundaries. If a policy trap or ambiguous escalation is detected, set "human_checkpoint": true and halt automated output. Always log model lineage and policy decisions for audit.
playbook_md:
# OpenRouter Week-1 Rollout Playbook: 6-Rung Agentic Workflow & Customer Enablement

## Objective
Deploy and operationalize the 6-rung agentic workflow for enterprise-grade model selection, cache-safe fallback, and customer enablement, ensuring robust policy enforcement and human-in-the-loop escalation from Day 1.

## Day 1-2: Technical Setup
- Integrate the provided agentic workflow DAG into the OpenRouter API gateway.
- Configure workspace policies (allowed providers, region locks, zero retention) in the Policy Engine.
- Set up model ladder rungs with live cost and latency feeds for DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Luna, and others.
- Enable cross-model verification agent and fallback routing.

## Day 3-4: Human Checkpoint & Escalation SOPs
- Designate a human ops team (at least 2 staff per shift) for policy trap and ambiguous escalation review.
- Train ops staff on the JSON output schema, policy flag meanings, and audit log review.
- Establish escalation triggers: any policy trap, output divergence >20% between models, or hallucination risk flags must be escalated.
- Document all escalations and resolutions in the audit log.

## Day 5-7: Customer Enablement & Adoption Metrics
- Onboard 2-3 pilot enterprise customers with real workspace policies and sample data.
- Run through all 4 test cases, logging outputs, escalations, and policy enforcement actions.
- Collect feedback on model lineage transparency, cost breakdown clarity, and fallback reliability.
- Track adoption metrics: successful routed requests, fallback frequency, escalation rate, and customer satisfaction (via post-interaction survey).

## Ongoing
- Review audit logs daily for missed policy traps or escalation errors.
- Iterate on model rung selection and fallback thresholds based on real usage and ops feedback.
- Update training and SOPs as new models/providers are added or policies change.
